title: Architectural Visualization for Urban Planning
business: Urban planning firms presenting large-scale city development projects to municipal stakeholders.
problem: Static 2D blueprints and physical models fail to convey the spatial impact of proposed high-rise developments, leading to prolonged approval cycles and stakeholder confusion regarding sunlight exposure and traffic flow.
solution: Utilizing the Unity engine to create an interactive, real-time 3D environment that allows stakeholders to navigate proposed urban developments, toggle between different architectural designs, and simulate environmental conditions like shadow casting.
steps: Import CAD-based building models into the Unity Editor using the FBX format to maintain structural scale.
Configure the Universal Render Pipeline to balance visual fidelity with the performance requirements of mobile or web-based presentation devices.
Implement the UI Toolkit to create an interactive overlay for toggling building variants and environmental time-of-day settings.
Utilize the Lighting system to bake or calculate real-time shadows, providing accurate visual feedback on how new structures impact existing public spaces.
outcome: Stakeholders gain a clear, intuitive understanding of spatial relationships and environmental impacts, resulting in more informed decision-making and accelerated project approval timelines.
limitation: The primary limitation is the trade-off between high-fidelity visual assets and runtime performance on target hardware. Developers must monitor frame rates and memory usage via the Profiler to ensure the experience remains fluid during interactive sessions.
